description: The handle line a turn carries for an attached video (app/src/tools/video.ts, core/crates/agent/src/video_handle.rs).

cases.name: an indexed video names its segments
cases.expected: [Video v1 "demo.mp4": 2m14s, 1920x1080, 30fps, 37 distinct segments. Use video_info, video_view or video_frame to look at it.]

cases.name: a video still indexing says so
cases.expected: [Video v2 "clip.mov": 1h03m, 720x1280, 29.97fps, index still building. Use video_info, video_view or video_frame to look at it.]

cases.name: a video that could not be indexed says so

cases.expected: [Video v1 "demo.mp4" attached. This model cannot see video frames; say so instead of guessing its contents.]
